customer_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the customer profile (one profile per Harborline account holder).

name.meaning: Full name of the account holder as registered on the profile; for business customers, the name of the authorised account contact.

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile belongs to a private individual or to a registered business entity; fixed at sign-up.

company_name.meaning: Registered legal name of the business for business customers; empty string for individuals.

email.meaning: Account contact email address on the profile (the address Harborline billing and security notices go to).

phone_number.meaning: Account contact phone number on the profile.

support_pin.meaning: Six-digit support PIN the customer set in the account dashboard for phone and chat verification.

card_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the default payment card on file.

billing_zip.format: 5-digit US ZIP or 6-character Canadian postal code, uppercase, no space
billing_zip.meaning: Billing postal code of the default payment method (US ZIP or Canadian postal code without space).

account_opened_date.meaning: Calendar date the Harborline profile was created.

country.format: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, uppercase (e.g. US, CA, GB)
country.meaning: Country of the profile's billing and contact address.

verification_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the identity-verification record (one per customer, updated on re-verification).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity was checked (refers to customers).

verified.meaning: Whether the caller passed identity verification; once true it never reverts to false.

verified_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the human-handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed over to a human representative (refers to customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

domain_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the domain holding.

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose Harborline account holds the domain (refers to customers).

variant_name.meaning: TLD registration product, written as the official product name matching the domain's extension.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the domain registration (see the domain charter lifecycle).

domain_name.meaning: Fully qualified domain name, lowercase, exactly as registered (e.g. bluefernbakery.com).

acquisition_type.meaning: How the domain came to Harborline: a new registration or an inbound transfer.

registered_date.meaning: Date the domain was registered through Harborline; for inbound transfers the date the transfer order was placed.

expiry_date.meaning: Current registration expiry date at the registry.

auto_renew.meaning: Whether auto-renew is switched on for the domain.

privacy_enabled.meaning: Whether WHOIS privacy protection is switched on.

registry_lock.meaning: Whether paid registry-level lock is in force on the domain.

nameservers.meaning: Whether the domain uses Harborline DNS nameservers or nameservers hosted elsewhere.

registrant_name.meaning: Registrant contact name on the domain record, verbatim.

registrant_org.meaning: Registrant organisation on the domain record, verbatim; empty string for individuals.

registrant_verified.meaning: Whether the registrant contact verification for the current registrant has been confirmed.

last_registrant_change_date.meaning: Date of the most recent change of registrant; empty string when there has been none.

change_lock_opt_out.meaning: Whether the registrant opted out of the change-of-registrant transfer lock at the most recent change of registrant (false when there has been none).

transfer_in_date.meaning: Date an inbound transfer completed; empty string for new registrations.

redemption_date.meaning: Date the domain entered the registry redemption period; empty string unless the domain is in or past redemption.

bundled_hosting_id.meaning: Hosting plan whose free-domain entitlement paid for the first registration year (refers to hosting_holdings); null when the registration was paid.

closed_date.meaning: Date the holding ended (deleted, transferred out or cancelled); empty string while open.

domain_charge_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the domain charge or refund line.

domain_id.meaning: Domain holding the line belongs to (refers to domain_holdings).

customer_id.meaning: Customer billed or refunded (refers to customers).

charge_type.meaning: What was billed; on a refund line, the type of the refunded charge.

amount.meaning: Amount of the line; charges are positive, refunds negative.

years.meaning: Registration or service years covered by the charge; 0 on refund lines.

charge_date.meaning: Date the charge was billed or the refund issued.

order_ref.format: HL- followed by 8 digits, or empty string
order_ref.meaning: Harborline order number the charge belongs to; empty string on refund lines.

payment_method.meaning: Funding source of a charge; none on refund lines.

original_domain_charge_id.meaning: On a refund line, the reference of the charge being refunded; null on charge lines.

refund_destination.meaning: Where a refund was returned; none on charge lines.

domain_event_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the domain service event.

customer_id.meaning: Customer concerned (refers to customers).

notice_kind.meaning: Kind of renewal notice; none for other events.

attempt_number.meaning: Auto-renew attempt sequence number; 0 for other events.

gaining_registrar.meaning: Gaining registrar named in an outbound transfer request, verbatim; empty string for other events.

transfer_decision.meaning: State of an outbound transfer request; none for other events.

auth_code_expires_date.meaning: Last valid date of an issued transfer authorisation code; empty string for other events.

account_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the Harborline account (one per customer profile).

customer_id.meaning: Customer profile that owns the account (refers to customers).

variant_name.meaning: Account tier, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the account (see the account charter lifecycle).

login_email.meaning: Sign-in email of the account dashboard, verbatim; may differ from the profile contact email.

credit_balance.meaning: Current account credit balance: always the sum of every account credit ledger entry of the account.

opened_date.meaning: Date the account was signed up.

tier_changed_date.meaning: Date the current tier took effect (the sign-up date if never changed).

recovery_hold_until.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ or empty string
recovery_hold_until.meaning: End of the current recovery waiting period; empty string when no recovery is pending.

last_security_change_date.meaning: Date of the last sign-in email or two-factor change; empty string if never changed.

lock_reason.meaning: Why the account is locked; none when it is not locked.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account was closed or purged; empty string while open.

credit_entry_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the credit ledger entry.

account_id.meaning: Account whose credit the entry moves (refers to account_holdings).

customer_id.meaning: Customer owning the account (refers to customers).

amount.meaning: Signed credit movement: additions positive, deductions negative.

funding_method.meaning: External payment method of a deposit, withdrawal or charge-back; none otherwise.

source_category.meaning: Product category of the charge refunded, paid or affected; none for deposits, withdrawals and charge-backs.

source_charge_ref.format: the reference number exactly as shown on the product charge or holding, or empty string
source_charge_ref.meaning: Reference number of the product charge refunded or paid, or of the affected holding for goodwill; empty string otherwise.

original_credit_entry_id.meaning: On a withdrawal or charge-back, the reference of the deposit entry it reverses; null otherwise.

account_event_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the account service event.

customer_id.meaning: Customer concerned (refers to customers).

notice_kind.meaning: Kind of security notice; none for other events.

lockout_ends_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ or empty string
lockout_ends_at.meaning: End of a temporary sign-in lockout; empty string for other events.

review_result.meaning: Result of a tier review; none for other events.

recovery_request_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the account recovery request.

customer_id.meaning: Customer the recovery is for (refers to customers).

account_id.meaning: Account to be recovered (refers to account_holdings).

requested_change.meaning: What the recovery will reset once applied.

new_login_email.meaning: Sign-in email to apply when the request changes it, verbatim as the customer gave it; empty string otherwise.

submitted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

decided_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ or empty string
decided_at.meaning: Moment Trust and Safety decided the request; empty string while submitted.

hosting_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the hosting plan.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who holds the plan (refers to customers).

variant_name.meaning: Hosting plan tier, written as the official plan name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the plan (see the hosting charter lifecycle).

primary_domain.meaning: Primary domain the plan was set up for, lowercase, verbatim (it may or may not be registered with Harborline).

billing_term_months.meaning: Length of the current billing term in months.

term_start_date.meaning: First day of the current paid term.

term_end_date.meaning: Day the current paid term ends and the next term would start (term start plus the term in calendar months).

first_term.meaning: Whether the current term is the plan's first (introductory) term.

opened_date.meaning: Date the plan was ordered; the money-back period counts from this date.

activated_date.meaning: Date provisioning completed; empty string while provisioning.

suspended_date.meaning: Date of the current suspension; empty string when not suspended.

suspension_reason.meaning: Cause of the current suspension; none when not suspended.

websites_in_use.meaning: Number of websites currently set up on the plan.

closed_date.meaning: Date the plan ended (cancelled or terminated); empty string while live.

hosting_charge_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the hosting charge, refund or credit line.

hosting_id.meaning: Hosting plan the line belongs to (refers to hosting_holdings).

customer_id.meaning: Customer billed, refunded or credited (refers to customers).

charge_type.meaning: What was billed; on a refund line the type of the refunded charge; sla_credit on uptime credit lines.

amount.meaning: Amount of the line; charges positive, refunds and credits negative.

term_months.meaning: Months covered by a term or renewal charge; 0 on other lines.

target_variant.meaning: On an upgrade line, the plan upgraded to; none on other lines.

period_start.meaning: First day covered by the line; empty string when not period-based.

period_end.meaning: Last day covered by the line; empty string when not period-based.

charge_date.meaning: Date the line was billed, refunded or credited.

order_ref.format: HL- followed by 8 digits, or empty string
order_ref.meaning: Harborline order number of a charge; empty string on refund and credit lines.

payment_method.meaning: Funding source of a charge; none on refund and credit lines.

original_hosting_charge_id.meaning: On a refund line, the reference of the charge refunded; null otherwise.

refund_kind.meaning: Rule under which a refund was given; none on other lines.

refund_destination.meaning: Where a refund or credit went; none on charge lines.

uptime_month.meaning: Calendar month an uptime credit covers; empty string on other lines.

hosting_event_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the hosting service event.

customer_id.meaning: Customer concerned (refers to customers).

event_at.meaning: Moment the event occurred or was recorded.

attempt_number.meaning: Auto-renew attempt number; 0 for other events.

resource.meaning: Resource a notice concerns; none for other events.

notice_level.meaning: Severity of a resource notice; none for other events.

measured_value.meaning: Usage measured for a resource notice (inodes as a count, storage in GB, CPU in percent of the limit); empty string for other events.

uptime_month.meaning: Calendar month of an uptime report; empty string for other events.

uptime_pct.format: percent, 3 decimal places, or empty string
uptime_pct.meaning: Measured monthly uptime; empty string for other events.

restore_point_date.meaning: Backup date restored from; empty string for other events.

performed_by.meaning: Who performed a restore; none for other events.

hosting_request_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the plan change request.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who made the request (refers to customers).

hosting_id.meaning: Hosting plan the request concerns (refers to hosting_holdings).

request_type.meaning: What is requested for the next renewal.

target_variant.meaning: Plan to move to at the next renewal (the current plan for a pure term change).

target_term_months.meaning: Billing term for the next renewal.

submitted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

effective_date.meaning: Date the change takes effect: the current term end date.

certificate_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the certificate subscription.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who holds the subscription (refers to customers).

variant_name.meaning: Certificate product, written as the official product name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the subscription (see the ssl charter lifecycle).

common_name.meaning: Primary name secured, lowercase, verbatim; wildcards begin with *.

extra_names.meaning: Names covered beyond the product's included names.

subscription_years.meaning: Years bought in the most recent purchase or renewal.

subscription_end_date.meaning: Date the subscription ends; no certificate may be valid beyond it.

cert_issued_date.meaning: Issue date of the current certificate; empty string before first issuance.

cert_expiry_date.meaning: Expiry date of the current certificate; empty string before first issuance.

dcv_method.meaning: Domain control validation method in use.

dcv_validated_date.meaning: Date domain control was last validated; empty string if never.

org_validated_date.meaning: Date organisation or extended validation last completed; empty string for DV or if never.

domain_id.meaning: Harborline domain holding of the covered registered domain (refers to domain_holdings); null when registered elsewhere.

hosting_id.meaning: Harborline hosting plan the certificate is installed on (refers to hosting_holdings); null when hosted elsewhere.

revocation_reason.meaning: Why the certificate was revoked; none unless revoked.

closed_date.meaning: Date the subscription ended (expired, revoked or cancelled); empty string while open.

ssl_charge_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the certificate charge or refund line.

certificate_id.meaning: Subscription the line belongs to (refers to ssl_holdings).

amount.meaning: Amount of the line; charges positive, refunds negative.

years.meaning: Subscription years covered; 0 on other lines.

names_added.meaning: Names added by an added_names line; 0 on other lines.

period_end.meaning: Last day covered; empty string when not period-based.

original_ssl_charge_id.meaning: On a refund line, the reference of the charge refunded; null otherwise.

refund_destination.meaning: Where a refund went; none on charge lines.

ssl_event_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the certificate service event.

customer_id.meaning: Customer concerned (refers to customers).

dcv_method.meaning: Method of a validation check; none for other events.

dcv_result.meaning: Result of a validation check; none for other events.

issuance_kind.meaning: Kind of issuance; none for other events.

cert_expiry_date.meaning: Expiry date of an issued certificate; empty string for other events.

reminder_kind.meaning: Which reminder was sent; none for other events.

email_plan_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the email subscription.

customer_id.meaning: Customer who holds the subscription (refers to customers).

variant_name.meaning: Email product, written as the official product name.

status.meaning: Lifecycle state of the subscription (see the email charter lifecycle).

email_domain.meaning: Domain the mailboxes use, lowercase, verbatim.

billing_plan.meaning: Billing plan of the current term.

term_start_date.meaning: First day of the current term.

term_end_date.meaning: Day the current term ends and the next would start.

scheduled_seat_count.meaning: Seat count scheduled for the next renewal; 0 when none is scheduled.

scheduled_variant.meaning: Product scheduled for the next renewal; none when no change is scheduled.

domain_id.meaning: Harborline domain holding of the email domain (refers to domain_holdings); null when registered elsewhere.

suspended_date.meaning: Date of the current suspension; empty string when not suspended.

expired_date.meaning: Date the subscription expired; empty string unless expired.

closed_date.meaning: Date the subscription ended; empty string while live.

original_email_charge_id.meaning: On a refund line, the reference of the charge refunded; null otherwise.

email_event_id.meaning: Primary reference number of the email service event.

customer_id.meaning: Customer concerned (refers to customers).

mailbox_address.meaning: Mailbox address concerned, verbatim; empty string for other events.

deleted_at.format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS TZ or empty string
